## Verdicts (rules of hypothesis card v9, applied verbatim)

| hypothesis | statistic | CI | rule | verdict (unadjusted) | one-sided bootstrap p | Holm-adjusted p | survives Holm (alpha 0.05) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| H15 robust selection works for classical | C-ens - R0 = +10.6 pp | 95% [+5.8, +15.4] | lower > 0 | **SUPPORTED** | 0.00005 (H0: diff<=0) | 0.00020 | yes |
| H15b robust selection + learned estimator eats headroom | B - R0 = +16.2 pp | 95% [+11.0, +21.4] | point >= +10 and lower > 0 | **SUPPORTED** | 0.00005 (H0: diff<=0, as H13 in v8) | 0.00020 | yes |
| H16a learned advantage | B - C-ens = +5.6 pp | 95% [+0.6, +10.6] | lower > 0 | **SUPPORTED** | 0.01620 (H0: diff<=0) | 0.03240 | yes |
| H16b learned advantage < 10 pp | B - C-ens = +5.6 pp | 95% [+0.6, +10.6] | upper < +10 | **NOT supported** | 0.04320 (H0: diff>=10) | 0.04320 | no |

Holm: step-down on the four one-sided bootstrap p-values (family of 4), family-wise alpha = 0.05 (v8.1 convention, same code as stats15.py). Unadjusted p floor = 1/(20000+1). H15b p uses H0: diff<=0 (the v8 H13 precedent); P*(B-R0 <= 10) = 0.01190 (descriptive).

**Interpretation sentence (v9, pre-written; applied on Holm-surviving verdicts): 學習式優勢可能 ≥10 pp，論文照實改寫 K2.** (Unadjusted verdicts alone would give: 學習式優勢可能 ≥10 pp，論文照實改寫 K2.)

## CPU seconds per episode (mean over 500 episodes; process CPU of the selection pipeline)

* B: planning + scoring in centre and 3 member models + 3 member-own plans (first, ordinary `_swing_start`): 20.4 s (median 19.5); plus L-dec4 inference (9 nets incl. descriptive ones, wall 5 s for the whole set, 0.01 s/episode wall, 3 nets would be ~1/3).
* C-ens: Laplace ensemble fit (12-start R0 fit + Jacobian posterior, `cls15d.ens_fit`) 42.9 s + same planning/scoring 20.4 s (median 19.5) = 63.3 s.
* B total with inference approx. 20.4 s (3 nets share of inference wall). Not counted: the R0 baseline episode itself, and the offline execution of all 11 candidates.
* Stage wall (8 workers): B collect 1014 s, LAP collect 1102 s, cls fits 3404 s (cpu 21447 s).

## Controls

* base candidate of the LAP run reproduces the independent R0 episode outcome in 100.0 % of episodes (B-run base candidate vs L-ens by construction).
* C-ens changes the R0 base pick in 80 % of episodes; ceiling (oracle best executed candidate): B-run 99.8 %, LAP-run 99.8 %.
